checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and pull all encounters in it: ED visits, urgent care, hospital admissions and observation stays, with reasons and discharge summaries.

Sepsis history (onset 1985) plus active tacrolimus: check for any infection-related encounters, antibiotic courses, fevers, or sepsis-related readmissions in the window, and whether infection follow-up was completed.

Tacrolimus (Envarsus, started 2026-04-25) monitoring: confirm trough level and kidney function labs were drawn on schedule during the window, review any dose changes, and flag any missed or out-of-range results for prescriber review.

Kidney function trend (diabetic kidney disease, microalbuminuria, proteinuria): compare creatinine/eGFR and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio over the window against prior values; flag any decline or new potassium abnormalities.
Lisinopril (started 2026-04-25) and blood pressure: review BP readings across the window for trend, orthostatic symptoms, dizziness or falls, and check potassium and creatinine after any dose change.

Simvastatin duplication: active list contains both Simvastatin 10 mg (started 2026-05-17) and Simvastatin 20 mg (started 2017-07-22). Verify with prescriber and pharmacy which is intended, whether one was stopped, and whether the patient is taking both; flag as a possible duplicate-therapy safety item.
Statin and tacrolimus interaction and muscle symptoms: with tacrolimus and a statin on the list, ask about myalgias or weakness and check any CK or liver labs ordered in the window.

Ischemic heart disease and antiplatelet/beta-blocker review: confirm clopidogrel and metoprolol succinate were continued without gaps, review any chest pain episodes, nitroglycerin spray use, and cardiology visits in the window.
Weight and BMI trend (obesity, BMI 30+): compare recorded weights across the window to prior values, note any unintentional change, and review diet, activity, and any weight-related care-plan goals.

Function, cognition, mood, caregiver and care-plan items: check ADL/IADL and mobility changes, falls, any cognitive or mood screens due, attendance at PACE day center, caregiver or transport changes, and care-plan goals or assessments that came due in the window.
